accessNotes: NO PRICES CAPTURED. The entire www/apex domain fundingpips.com (and app./dashboard. subdomains) sits behind a Vercel bot-protection interstitial. Every request - WebFetch and direct curl with a real browser User-Agent - returned HTTP 429/403 with a 33KB HTML body whose <title> is 'Vercel Security Checkpoint'. This affects EVERY path including /pricing, /challenges, /trading-objectives, /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml. The purchase/checkout pricing table is therefore unreadable, so every priceUsd is null. The ONLY officially readable FundingPips property is the Zendesk help centre at help.fundingpips.com, which is an official FundingPips-operated subdomain and was reachable (HTTP 200) via its public Help Center API. All rule/percentage data below comes from there and every article was last updated 2026-07-24, three days before capture. IMPORTANT: help.fundingpips.com documents rules and account SIZES but never states a challenge purchase fee anywhere - the only fee references are relative reset discounts ('15% off the purchase price'). I deliberately did NOT use propfirmmatch, propfirmsfinder, brokeranalysis or any other aggregator that surfaced in search, so the '~$66 for the $10K tier' figure currently in our review remains UNVERIFIED and unsupported.

rules.news: Evaluation: no restrictions. Master Account: cannot open or close positions within a 10-minute window (5 min before / 5 min after) around a high-impact (red folder, Forex Factory) event on affected currencies; profits from such trades are deducted. Trades opened 5+ hours before the event are exempt. Purposely trading news is prohibited and leads to account closure.
rules.weekend: Permitted during evaluation. TEMPORARILY NOT ALLOWED on 1 Step Flex Master Accounts since 29 January 2026; system auto-closes open trades, not a hard breach.
rules.overnight: Allowed. Optional paid Swap-Free add-on (MT5 only, Forex and Metals) removes overnight swap charges.
rules.ea: Third-party EAs permitted only as a trade or risk manager; any other use causes denial and account closure. Personal EAs developed by you may fully automate with proof of ownership.
rules.copyTrading: Permitted between your own FundingPips accounts, and outbound to an external account. Prohibited between accounts owned by different users and inbound from external signal providers.

notes: maxLossPct of 5% is a TRAILING limit on peak equity, not a static floor - it is not comparable like-for-like with the 6-12% static limits on the evaluation models. It locks at the starting account size once equity reaches 5% profit.
Max Open Risk Limit 1%: 'Floating PnL cannot exceed -1% of the starting account size at any time' - hard breach.
Risk Per Trade Idea: 3% below $50K, 2% at $50K and above.
Min Profitable Days: at least 7 profitable days (0.25%+ each) per rolling 30-day period - failing this is listed under hard breaches.

Reward eligibility needs all four of: consistency score <=15%, 7 profitable days in the rolling 30-day period, a 3% safety cushion (first 3% profit not eligible for reward), and biggest losing day not exceeding biggest winning day.
Reset available at a 20% discount for all account sizes.
